columns.description: Column definitions. Each item: { key, header, render, align, sortable, width, pin, primary, hidden, aggregate, footer, className, headerClassName }.

primaryKey.description: Property name used as the unique row identifier.

scrollable.description: Wrap the table in a horizontally-scrollable container.

responsive.description: Responsive mode: 'stack' or 'stack-header' for mobile stacking behaviour.

stickyHeader.description: Keep the header row visible while scrolling (usa-table--sticky-header).

stickyFirstColumn.description: Sticky-pin the first column on horizontal scroll.

sortable.description: Enable sorting on all columns (individual columns can opt out via column.sortable: false).

sort.description: Controlled sort state: { key: string, direction: 'asc' | 'desc' | null }.

onSort.description: Callback fired when a column header is clicked: ({ key, direction }) => void.

selectionMode.description: Row selection mode. 'checkbox' enables multi-select; 'radio' enables single-select.

select.description: Controlled array of selected primary key values.

onSelect.description: Callback fired when selection changes: (selectedKeys[]) => void.

allowSelectAll.description: Show 'select all' checkbox in header (checkbox mode only).

disabled.description: Array of primary key values for rows that should be non-interactive.

onClickRow.description: Callback fired when a row is clicked: (rowData, event) => void.

groupBy.description: Group rows by a property. String shorthand or object: { property, expand, onExpand, defaultExpanded }.

rowDetails.description: Enable expandable row detail panels. Function: (row) => ReactNode. Object: { render, expand, onExpand, expandLabel }.

showFooter.description: Render a <tfoot> row using column.footer or column.aggregate values.

paginate.description: Enable pagination. true for client-side; object { pageSize, totalCount, onPageChange } for server-side.

onMore.description: Infinite scroll callback, called when the last row becomes visible.

placeholder.description: Content shown when the data array is empty.

className.description: Additional CSS classes applied to the <table> element.
